{{Quote|Rukh, clan Baikh'vair, we salute your sacrifice. Die with honor.''"<br />"''Go with luck, Akh'laht, clan Kihm'bar.|Akh'laht and Rukh|<ref name="Setting">{{WEGCite|story=Setting Things Right|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
'''Akh'laht''' was a [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] of [[Clan Kihm'bar]] and one of the [[Noghri Death Commando]]s. After the Empire's deception to the Noghri was revealed, he informed [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]], the [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], of this revelation. Rukh then promised to make the Grand Admiral pay, which he did, during the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]].
